- **positioning.accepts_now / framing_required / recent (2024-2026) article titles**: Could not load the current-issue TOC (tandfonline.com/toc/tpsr20/current returned 403) or any accessible 2024-2026 special-issue CFP page; positioning is based only on the journal's static aims-and-scope description, not on verified recent publication topics.
